WorkspaceCookie.name: ynsg-access
WorkspaceCookie.description: Secure, HttpOnly, host-only, same-site session. Never read or forward through native JavaScript.

x-ynsg-runtime-rules: Exact revisions and actor-bound same-input receipts are enforced in SQL.
Save work + completion is atomic; timer stops without automatic invoice/payment.
Invoice charges/tax require actual agreement and owner review.
Notification lock-screen payloads contain no customer contacts or financial figures.
POST limits: commands 12000 bytes; work 120000 bytes; phone device 4096 bytes; invoice record 4096 bytes; conversation note 17000 bytes; tax entry 100000 bytes; calendar block 4096 bytes.
Hourly billing arithmetic, no-charge reason and customer-approved cap are additional runtime/SQL refinements.
